children: Coinbase Global reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.22B, down 34.9% from $1.87B a year earlier, while net income rose 66.1% to $718.7M and diluted EPS increased to $2.51 from $1.5. Lower transaction revenue weighed on the top line.
Revenue was $1.22B, compared with $1.87B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (34.9%).
Net income was $718.7M, compared with $432.6M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 66.1%.
Diluted EPS was $2.51, compared with $1.50 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 67.3%.
Net revenue fell 33% to $1.2B, as transaction revenue declined 44% and subscriptions and services revenue decreased 20%.
Consumer spot trading volume fell 59%, while institutional spot volume dropped 53%; derivatives activity held up, and Coinbase launched prediction markets.
The company expanded tradable assets, grew equities and prediction-market activity, and reported record average USDC balances.
Coinbase also reported growth in decentralized exchange trading and balances borrowed and lent, supporting its focus on stablecoins, payments, and onchain adoption.
For 2026, Coinbase expects technology, general and administrative, and sales and marketing costs, excluding intangible amortization, to be slightly below 2025 levels.
